verdicts.reason: A is a uniformly shrunk copy of the original. The order and hierarchy survive, but the logo wordmark, eyebrow, body copy, the 'Reserve a Case' label and the legal line are all too small to read at 300x250, and there is dead space under the CTA. B reflows into two columns and keeps the headline legible, but the body copy is now far larger than the CTA. The button and 'Ships late June' are shrunk to a tiny cluster on the right next to an unreadable legal block, so the CTA is buried and the hierarchy is inverted. B also appears to drop the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow and leaves the divider floating. Both are broken, and A is slightly less bad because the CTA still reads as the focal action.
